large_lateral_impulse.description: Forward locomotion at 1.5 m/s under a large lateral ramp impulse. The paper reports FACET robustness up to about 200 Ns and trajectory examples at 400 N peak force.

impulse_recovery_score.description: Composite benefit metric combining survival and retained forward motion.

mean_final_forward_speed_mps.description: Constraint metric checking that the controller continues moving forward after the disturbance.

success_rate.description: Fraction of trials that avoid the benchmark fall condition under the lateral impulse.

large_lateral_impulse.notes: The paper reports success curves graphically rather than this composite score. The reduced benchmark uses impulse_recovery_score = success_rate * max(final_forward_speed, 0) / 1.5 so that survival without locomotion progress is not rewarded.

soft_wall_collision.description: Wall collision at 1.5 m/s. The paper reports that the compliant FACET setting reduces collision impulse by about 80% relative to the robust velocity baseline.

collision_impulse_reduction.description: Relative reduction in total reduced-benchmark wall impulse versus the fixed robust velocity baseline.

mean_wall_entry_speed_mps.description: Constraint metric discouraging methods from reducing impulse by slowing down before contact.

post_contact_impulse_reduction.description: Relative reduction in wall impulse during the first 0.5 seconds after contact versus the fixed robust velocity baseline.

wall_contact_rate.description: Task-validity check that the controller actually reaches the wall.

soft_wall_collision.notes: The paper reports an approximately 80% wall-impulse reduction from a plotted distribution. The reduced benchmark keeps that headline as collision_impulse_reduction and additionally reports a stricter first-0.5s post-contact reduction calibrated from the reproduced artifact.
